crimson-marquee.$description: Crimson Marquee — Brand wordmark bar, release-date tags, selected-state borders, and the singular chromatic accent that anchors an otherwise monochrome system — deep, slightly oxidized, never orange, never bright

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, icon strokes, heading color, button text, and dark-surface fills (hero overlay, footer)

paper.$description: Paper — Page background, card surface, button text on dark fills, input fields, badge text

bone.$description: Bone — Alternate card surface and section background, used to separate one row of film tiles from the next without a hard divider

silver.$description: Silver — Hairline borders on cards, buttons, inputs, and dividers — the universal 1px rule that frames almost every element

smoke.$description: Smoke — Secondary surface tint and shadow base; used sparingly where a surface needs to read as slightly recessed from Bone

cornflower.$description: Cornflower — Focus ring and link/hover halo only — a cool sky-blue that signals interactivity without competing with the crimson brand color

flatspot.$description: (Letter-spacing note) Body and body-small run on -0.010em to -0.011em tracking; the 9-10px caption/metadata tier sits at -0.012em — tighter as the size shrinks, which is unusual and gives the tiniest text a compressed, almost stenciled feel.

girott.$description: Display-only face used for page heroes and feature titles. The 160px / 0.80 line-height / -0.031em tracking combination is the signature move: a single film title bleeds across the full viewport edge-to-edge, set tight against itself so descenders nearly touch ascenders. The 36-42px range covers secondary display moments (sub-hero headlines, featured card titles).
